policy: Public-source research only. No automatic outreach, no unverified UK follower share, no score attribution or database import.
researchMethod: Publicly indexed creator-authored articles and indexed third-party sponsored Instagram posts; verify originals before classification as confirmed firsthand reviews.

socialCreators.name: Rebecca Fenney
socialCreators.evidence: Indexed Oct 22 Instagram post says she has been using the Ulike Air10 for home hair removal; second listed post Aug 15 also says she has used it.
needsVerification: Open original Instagram post and confirm specific account identity
Confirm personal treatment detail and material connection disclosures
Verify UK audience demographics and engagement from dated data
Verify any exclusivity or existing brand relationship

socialCreators.name: Gaby Starbuck
socialCreators.evidence: Indexed Oct 19 Instagram post says she has been trying Ulike Air 10 as part of an at-home hair-removal routine.
needsVerification: Open original Instagram post and verify claims and disclosure
Check fit for CYPH/1 beauty-tech audience
Confirm UK share of followers independently

socialCreators.name: Chloe Haycock
socialCreators.evidence: Indexed Sep 23 post caption says 14 days testing Ulike Air 10; separate indexed TikTok mirror shows same self-reported test wording.
needsVerification: Do not assume Instagram and TikTok follower counts are equal
Assess suitability of parenting/lifestyle audience rather than just reach
Confirm UK follower distribution and possible brand exclusivity

socialCreators.name: Laura Orgill
socialCreators.evidence: Indexed Aug 28 post reports surprise at perceived hair-reduction patches from Ulike; exact model and testing method not independently verified.
needsVerification: Verify original content and exact device model
Identify personal use versus scripted sponsor copy
Verify account, geographic audience and engagement

socialCreators.name: Debbie Attwood
socialCreators.evidence: Indexed Jul 31 beauty post discusses Air 10 treatment time and comfort; detailed personal treatment history unverified.
needsVerification: Verify original post and personal experience
Confirm actual UK-audience proportion, current reach and engagement
Check product-claim accuracy and sponsorship disclosures

editorialReviewers.name: Laura Gladman
editorialReviewers.evidence: Long-form firsthand testing with named body areas, device comparisons and affiliate disclosures; social account and collaboration availability unverified.

editorialReviewers.name: Lise Smith
editorialReviewers.evidence: Guardian comparative review (updated July 2026) describes 13 devices tested with repeat sessions and control area; primarily an editorial opportunity, not a verified social creator.

editorialReviewers.name: Sally Underwood
editorialReviewers.evidence: Personally reported two weeks of Ulike Air 10 use with before/after photographs, published Jan 31 2026; Ulike approached her and article includes affiliate disclosure.

editorialReviewers.name: Natalie Dixon
editorialReviewers.evidence: Personal Ulike Air 10 use described in March 29 2025 NationalWorld review, with affiliate disclosure; editorial, not automatically a verified Instagram micro-influencer.

decision: Keep new people outside growth.prospects until identity, social source URL, dated evidence and restrictions reviewed under existing research import policy. No automatic dedup, outreach, rank or influence claims.
